summary: Autoliv (issuer) filed an 8-K reporting management approval of a plan to close its manufacturing plants in Türkiye, ceasing steering wheel, airbag, and seatbelt production. The expected pre-tax charge is ~$142M (Q2 2026), with ~$129M cash costs for severance and $13M non-cash write-offs. Annual pre-tax benefit of ~$40M is anticipated from 2027, fully realized by 2028, with ~2,200 employees reduced. The plan addresses excess EMEA capacity. Watch for execution risk in the Turkish Lira currency exposure and regulatory/timing aspects of the closures.
